The journey

What actually happens, in order.

No treatment is booked before you have a written plan and a fixed price. Everything after that is logistics, and the logistics are ours.

Before you travel

Remote assessment

You send photographs and any recent X-rays through the enquiry form or WhatsApp. A partner dentist reviews them and returns a written treatment plan with a fixed, itemised price — before you commit to anything.

Day one

Arrival and transfer

You are met at Istanbul Airport and driven to your hotel. Your coordinator handles the schedule, the clinic appointments and translation for the whole stay.

Throughout your stay

Accommodation

Partner hotels are chosen for proximity to the clinic and for rest — recovery is part of the treatment, not an afterthought.

At the clinic

Treatment and planning

Digital scans, smile design and the treatment itself, carried out by the partner clinical team. You see the plan on screen and approve it before work begins.

The journey in detail

Send your photographs. Get a written plan.

A partner dentist reviews your photographs and any recent X-rays, then returns an itemised treatment plan with a fixed price. There is no charge for the assessment and no obligation afterwards.

VeaHealth Istanbul · Turkey

VeaHealth is a medical tourism coordinator based in Istanbul. Treatment is carried out by licensed partner clinics and their clinical teams. Information on this site is general and is not a substitute for a consultation, diagnosis or treatment plan from a qualified clinician.
